subject: MAP: staged onramp & security gating — SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA & retention thresholds
messages:
From: Elena Morales <emorales@northstarbank.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@northstarbank.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff & MAP request — security gates

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. NorthStar's security and procurement team asked me to capture a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on the security/compliance gates needed to move to a production pilot. Key asks from our side: SOC 2 report access (redacted is fine), completed SIG/CAIQ matrix, DPA redline with data retention clause (we need 7-year transactional retention with EU residency for certain flows), and an acceptance checklist for the pilot (what constitutes "security acceptance").

Our rough timeline: procurement review by 9/1, security intake by 9/15, and pilot decision by 10/1. Can your team circulate a MAP we can review, and confirm what evidence you can provide in the short term?

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Risk & Controls
NorthStar Bank

Attachments: none
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <emorales@northstarbank.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & MAP request — security gates

Hi Elena — great to meet you on the call. Appreciate the timeline; we can work to meet it. I’ve attached a draft MAP that maps milestones to the security artifacts you requested and a short owner list so responsibilities are clear. Short answers up front:

- SOC 2: we can provide the redacted Type II report (2027) and an SOC 2 scope summary by 8/21.
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll provide a completed CAIQ matrix (v1) by 8/24.
- DPA: we can send a DPA with our standard retention language; I’ve included a preliminary redline for your counsel to review.
- Data residency: we can support EU residency for token storage for EU-scoped traffic; Marcus below adds technical notes.

Next steps: I’ll update the MAP with the dates above and include a short acceptance checklist for pilot success criteria. If procurement prefers DocuSign, we can route once the DPA text is agreed.

Attached: MAP_draft_2028-08-14.xlsx, SOC2_report_redacted_2027.pdf

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0189
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <emorales@northstarbank.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & MAP request — security gates

Elena / Neha — quick tech clarifications to feed the MAP:

- EU residency: we isolate token and KV caches for EU-region customers. For the pilot, we can host inference-only traffic in eu-west-1 and ensure customer data at rest is in-region.
- SOC 2 scoping: our current SOC 2 Type II covers hosted API and platform controls; Dedicated/Private deployments have different evidence paths — I'll flag where that differs in the matrix.
- Logs & retention: we retain request/trace logs for 90 days by default; we can offer extended retention (7 years) under an enterprise contract with explicit storage/archival procedures (cost + legal signoff).
- SIG/CAIQ: several answers require linking to docs (KMS keys, encryption suites) — attaching a working CAIQ; Kim can validate.

Attachment: SIG_CAIQ_matrix_v1.xlsx

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Inference Platform
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <emorales@northstarbank.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & MAP request — security gates

Hi Elena — looping in a couple items from security/legal: 

1) SIG/CAIQ: I reviewed marcus's draft. A few high-impact clarifications we can provide immediately: encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+), envelope encryption with customer KMS only in Dedicated/Private, and key lifecycle policies. I marked those cells in the CAIQ.
2) DPA redline: I reviewed your note on 7-year retention. Our standard DPA sets default retention at 90 days for logs; for transactional retention beyond 1 year we require Appendix A (storage addendum) — I put an example clause in DPA_redline_NorthStar_2028-09-06.docx.
3) Evidence delivery: we can provide redacted SOC 2 and a control narrative by 8/21. For SOC 2 auditor contact or bridge letters, we can provide an authority contact with NDA.

If procurement/legal at NorthStar want revised language, please have counsel send specific redlines; Luis from Acme Legal copied below can coordinate.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: SIG_CAIQ_matrix_v1.xlsx (updated), DPA_redline_NorthStar_2028-09-06.docx
From: Elena Morales <emorales@northstarbank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@northstarbank.com>, Luis Ramirez <luis.ramirez@acmelegal.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Sep 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & MAP request — security gates

Thanks — that's helpful. Procurement wants to push the internal review to week of 9/11; security is still targeting 9/15 for intake. Two asks from procurement/legal:

- Can you surface an explicit cost estimate for the extended retention appendix (ballpark monthly – we understand this is usage dependent)?
- We need DocuSign-ready DPA with your standard IP & liability caps visible; please upload final DPA so our legal lead (Luis) can mark.

If you can send the cost stub and DocuSign link by 9/6, we can keep to our milestone dates.

Elena

-- Forwarded message --
From: Procurement Team <procurement@northstarbank.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Sep 2028 08:25:00 -07:00
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Subject: Cost ask: extended retention

Procurement: Please provide approximate incremental storage costs and any archival retrieval fees.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <emorales@northstarbank.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & MAP request — security gates

Elena / team — thanks for the patience while we internalized procurement's asks. Quick summary and commitments so we have a canonical MAP update: 

- Evidence: redacted SOC 2 Type II (2027) and a 1-page control narrative will be uploaded to the HubSpot deal and shared link by 2028-09-21. Auditor contact available under NDA.
- SIG/CAIQ: final v1 completed and attached to the MAP (Kim and Marcus validated).
- DPA: we can accept a 7-year retention appendix under enterprise pricing. I asked finance to provide a retention estimate; a conservative ballpark is $0.015 per GB/month for cold archival plus a small retrieval fee. Fine-tuning will be in the DPA Appendix A.
- DocuSign: once counsel agrees on the DPA redline, we will route via DocuSign. Neha will share the DocuSign envelope link (ND-4821).
- Acceptance criteria for pilot: (1) SOC 2 controls evidenced and agreed exceptions captured; (2) SIG cells rated acceptable for risk team; (3) DPA signed with retention appendix; (4) pilot traffic routed to eu-west-1 for EU-scoped data.

Next actions: Neha will upload the artifacts and create an updated MAP on the HubSpot deal (HS-53921). If procurement wants final cost numbers earlier, I can loop finance into the thread.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachments: none (artifact links to be posted to HubSpot)
